dialogue.townstead_social.little_pleasur: What makes an ordinary day a good one for you?
If you had an hour entirely to yourself, how would you spend it?
Something simple. A quiet walk and someone worth talking to.
A warm meal, a little fresh air, and no hurry to be anywhere.
An hour without somebody asking me questions would be a start.
Getting through my work without a fresh problem, mostly.
That sounds like a better ambition than being busy all the time.
We should leave ourselves room for more days like that.
Fair enough. I can leave a little room for quiet.
I suppose a peaceful day means different things to different people.
Especially if the company is good. This has been nice.
Agreed. A day does not have to be remarkable to be worth having.
Quiet would be appreciated. Nothing personal.
Exactly. We do not all need the same sort of day.
dialogue.townstead_social.craft_and_pati: Do you think making something well matters more than making it quickly?
Would you rather finish a task early or take the time to get every detail right?
Well, if I can manage it. Care shows, even in small things.
I like knowing something will last. That is worth a little patience.
Quickly. A perfect job that never gets finished is not much use.
There is always another task waiting. You have to know when to stop fussing.
There is something satisfying about work you can stand behind.
Perhaps the trick is caring about the details that actually matter.
I see your point. Still, some mistakes cost more time than they save.
Maybe. I would hate to hurry so much that I stopped taking pride in it.
That is a fair way to put it. Careful does not have to mean slow.
Yes. I think we would make a good team on a job like that.
And I would hate to polish one thing while ten others fell apart.
We may have to disagree on this one. There is only so much daylight.
dialogue.townstead_social.shared_trade.o: Do you ever find yourself thinking about the work even when you have stopped?
What do you find harder about our sort of work: starting, or knowing when to stop?
dialogue.townstead_social.shared_trade.w: Knowing when to stop. There is always one more thing I want to put right.
All the time. A small improvement will occur to me when I am meant to be resting.
dialogue.townstead_social.shared_trade.c: Starting. Some mornings I would rather be almost anywhere else.
Once I stop, I try very hard not to think about it at all.
dialogue.townstead_social.shared_trade.f: It helps talking with somebody who understands that feeling.
I am glad it is not just me. We ought to compare ideas more often.
I can understand that. Everyone needs a part of the day that belongs to them.
Perhaps we both need a little more distance from the work.
dialogue.townstead_social.shared_trade.e: I would like that. Another pair of eyes can make all the difference.
Same here. You understand without making me explain every little thing.
Exactly. We have more in common than you might think.
A little breathing room would do us both good.
dialogue.townstead_social.rain.open.1: Does rain make you restless, or does it help you slow down?
dialogue.townstead_social.rain.open.2: I like the sound of rain. Do you, or does it just make you think of wet boots?
dialogue.townstead_social.rain.warm.1: It helps me slow down. The world sounds a little less hurried.
dialogue.townstead_social.rain.warm.2: The sound, yes. It makes a dry place feel twice as welcoming.
dialogue.townstead_social.rain.cool.2: Restless. I keep thinking of everything that would be easier in dry weather.
dialogue.townstead_social.rain.follow_wa: Perhaps that is why I like it. It gives us an excuse to pause.
It is strange how the same place can feel different when it rains.
dialogue.townstead_social.rain.follow_co: You have a point. The sound is easier to enjoy when you are comfortable.
I will admit that puddles are less charming from inside your shoes.
Then let us enjoy the pause while it lasts.
And good company makes the weather matter a little less.
At last, a sensible view of the weather.
Exactly. I will enjoy it more when it stops.
dialogue.townstead_social.reassurance.op: I cannot seem to shake this low feeling today.
Do you ever have a day when everything feels a little heavier than it should?
dialogue.townstead_social.reassurance.wa: Yes. You do not have to explain it perfectly for me to listen.
I do. Would it help to talk, or would you rather just have some company?
dialogue.townstead_social.reassurance.co: We all have difficult days. There is not always much to say about it.
I usually keep busy until it passes. Thinking about it can make it worse.
dialogue.townstead_social.reassurance.fo: Company would help. Thank you for not trying to hurry me out of it.
Just being heard helps more than I expected.
Perhaps. I was hoping for a little understanding more than advice.
Keeping busy is not quite what I need right now.
dialogue.townstead_social.reassurance.en: Then I am glad we talked. You need not carry the whole day alone.
Any time. We can take the next little bit of the day as it comes.
I did not mean to make it worse. I am not very good at these conversations.
I see. I should probably have listened first.
dialogue.townstead_social.repair.open.1: Could we start again? I would rather understand you than keep rubbing you the wrong way.
dialogue.townstead_social.repair.open.2: I do not like how things feel between us. Could we talk about it?
dialogue.townstead_social.repair.warm.1: I would like that. Neither of us has to win every conversation.
dialogue.townstead_social.repair.warm.2: All right. I can try to listen without expecting the worst.
dialogue.townstead_social.repair.cool.1: I am not ready to pretend everything is fine.
dialogue.townstead_social.repair.cool.2: Perhaps another time. I still need a little space.
dialogue.townstead_social.repair.follow_: I can do that too. We are allowed to see things differently.
Thank you. I will try not to assume I already know what you mean.
I can respect that. I wanted you to know the door was open.
Then I will give you space. We can try again when it feels right.
dialogue.townstead_social.repair.end_war: That is a better place to start. I am glad you said something.
So will I. Let us leave a little room for each other.
dialogue.townstead_social.repair.end_coo: Thank you for understanding that much.
dialogue.townstead_social.remembered_kin: I remember you listening when I was having a hard day. It mattered.
I have been meaning to thank you for being kind when I needed it.
I am glad it helped. You would not need to earn that from me.
Thank you for telling me. I was hoping you felt a little less alone.
There is no need to make a great thing of it.
I only listened. I did not do anything extraordinary.
Perhaps not, but ordinary kindness is still worth remembering.
It did help. I would like you to know you can count on me as well.
That is exactly why I wanted to say it. Small things can matter.
I will not make a fuss. I just wanted you to know.
Then I am glad we have each other to talk to.
That means a lot. Thank you.
Well... thank you for saying so.
dialogue.townstead_social.food.open.1: I am starting to think more about a meal than anything else. What sounds good to you?
dialogue.townstead_social.food.open.2: If you could choose a comforting meal right now, what would it be?
dialogue.townstead_social.food.warm.1: Something warm and simple. Good bread would be a fine start.
dialogue.townstead_social.food.warm.2: A proper bowl of something hearty. The sort you take your time over.
dialogue.townstead_social.food.cool.1: Whatever is ready. Hunger makes me rather less particular.
dialogue.townstead_social.food.cool.2: Something I do not have to spend all afternoon preparing.
dialogue.townstead_social.food.follow_wa: Food does seem better when you are not rushing through it.
That sounds good. Some day we should make time for a meal together.
dialogue.townstead_social.food.follow_co: There is wisdom in that. A meal does have to exist before you can enjoy it.
Fair enough. Perhaps we should think about finding one.
I would enjoy that. Good company is part of a good meal.
Agreed. We should make room for simple pleasures like that.
Now that sounds like a practical plan.
Yes. Before talking about food makes us hungrier.
dialogue.townstead_social.joke.open.1: I was going to tell you a joke about a broken clock, but the timing is terrible.
dialogue.townstead_social.joke.open.2: I tried to think of a joke about a staircase. It went downhill from there.
dialogue.townstead_social.joke.warm.1: That was awful. Tell me another one.
dialogue.townstead_social.joke.warm.2: I should not have laughed at that nearly as much as I did.
dialogue.townstead_social.joke.cool.2: I think that one needed a little more work.
dialogue.townstead_social.joke.follow_wa: I shall take that as encouragement, against your better judgment.
Then my work here is done. A small laugh is still a laugh.
dialogue.townstead_social.joke.follow_co: A fair review. I will spare you the next one.
They cannot all be good. Apparently that one could not be good at all.
Against my better judgment, yes. You did brighten my day.
I needed that. Thank you for the truly dreadful joke.
That last part was almost funny. Almost.
dialogue.townstead_social.change.open.1: Would you rather know what tomorrow will bring, or be surprised by it?
dialogue.townstead_social.change.open.2: Do you find change exciting, or would you rather things stayed familiar?
dialogue.townstead_social.change.warm.1: A little surprise keeps life interesting. Not every change has to be a calamity.
dialogue.townstead_social.change.warm.2: Exciting, usually. There might be something good I had not thought to hope for.
dialogue.townstead_social.change.cool.1: Familiar. There is comfort in knowing where you stand.
dialogue.townstead_social.change.cool.2: I would rather know. Surprises are not always pleasant.
dialogue.townstead_social.change.follow_: I like that way of looking at it. There is room for something better.
Perhaps we should be a little more willing to try things.
I understand the comfort. I would still hate to miss something good.
Maybe the best sort of change leaves you something familiar to come back to.
dialogue.townstead_social.change.end_war: As long as we can laugh when it does not go to plan.
Yes. A little curiosity can take you a long way.
dialogue.townstead_social.change.end_coo: That, I could agree with. A place to come back to matters.
Perhaps. I would rather take it one small change at a time.
dialogue.townstead_social.checking_after: I saw what happened. Are you hurt badly?
That looked painful. How are you holding up?
You frightened me back there. Are you all right?
I will mend. Thank you for asking.
It still aches, but I am glad you noticed.
I am shaken more than hurt, if I am honest.
I have endured worse. Do not fuss.
It was nothing I could not handle.
I would rather everyone stopped staring.
Then let me carry something for you today.
You can rest near me until your hands stop shaking.
All right. I will be nearby if that changes.
I hear you. I will leave it alone.
A little company would help, actually.
Thank you. I do not want to be alone just yet.
Good. Let us speak of something else.
Thank you. I need quiet more than questions.
dialogue.townstead_social.speaking_after: I know you saw that. I did not want you worrying.
About what happened earlier... I am still here.
You looked more shaken by that blow than I was.
Seeing it was enough. You need not protect me from concern.
I was afraid. I am relieved to hear your voice now.
Being alive does not mean you must pretend it was easy.
You are standing. That is answer enough.
There is no sense turning one bad moment over all day.
Let us leave it where it happened.
For a moment, I was not sure I would get back up.
Perhaps you are right. I only wanted you to know.
Very well. We can let the silence have it.
Then we can be relieved together.
Thank you for telling me. The fear feels smaller now.
I understand. We need not speak of it again.
All right. Let us get on with the day.
